title: Migrations Overview
description: Understand how Prisma Migrate works and the role of migrations in database schema evolution.

data.text: Prisma Migrate keeps your database schema in sync with your Prisma schema. It generates SQL migration files that can be applied to any environment, ensuring consistent schema changes across development, staging, and production.

items: `prisma migrate dev` compares the current schema to the database and generates a migration
`prisma migrate deploy` applies migrations in production

rows: Create and apply a new migration
Drop database and reapply all migrations

data.title: Important
data.text: Never run `prisma migrate dev` in production. Use `prisma migrate deploy` instead, which applies existing migrations without attempting to modify the schema.
